notes: Files are byte-for-byte copies of the archived originals fetched via the im_ (raw) URL form; filenames carry the first 8 hex chars of the file's sha256.

thumbnail_only=true means the archive only had a WordPress -WxH thumbnail for that upload; the full-size original was not captured.
Only images under about_page_use are shown on the site (About page). Everything else is stored and listed only.
